# Country scope. Qing 2.0 host check (reuses verified oe_pmch_is_host: non-rebel MCH or jurchen_group tribe; never absent QNG/JNZ!).
oe_qg2_is_host = {
	oe_pmch_is_host = yes
}

# Country scope. Safe member check for non-unique vanilla international_organization_type:jurchen_confederation.
oe_qg2_in_jurchen_confederation = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	any_international_organizations_member_of = {
		international_organization_type = international_organization_type:jurchen_confederation
	}
}

# Country scope. True when Manchu/Qing holds Beijing and substantial southern Chinese territory, making Three Feudatories eligible.
oe_qg2_three_feudatories_eligible = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	oe_qg2_is_host = yes
	owns = location:dadu
	OR = {
		owns = location:kunming
		owns = location:minxian
		owns = location:guangzhou
		owns = location:panyu
		owns = location:shangyuan
		num_locations >= 45
	}
}

# Any scope. Outcome 1 of oe_sit_three_feudatories: Imperial Centralization Triumph.
oe_qg2_tf_imperial_victory = {
	OR = {
		has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_force_imperial
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_progress
			global_var:oe_qg2_tf_progress >= 80
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_tension
			global_var:oe_qg2_tf_tension <= 15
			has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_months
			global_var:oe_qg2_tf_months >= 24
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Outcome 2 of oe_sit_three_feudatories: Southern Feudatories Entrenched.
oe_qg2_tf_feudatory_autonomy = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { country_exists = c:MCH }
		AND = {
			country_exists = c:MCH
			NOT = { c:MCH = { owns = location:dadu } }
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_tension
			global_var:oe_qg2_tf_tension >= 90
		}
		AND = {
			has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_months
			global_var:oe_qg2_tf_months >= 144
			has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_progress
			global_var:oe_qg2_tf_progress < 50
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Outcome 3 of oe_sit_three_feudatories: Negotiated Southern Pacification.
oe_qg2_tf_negotiated_settlement = {
	has_global_variable = oe_qg2_tf_months
